paite: Kikaikhawm un, ahi, kikaikhawm un, zumna nei lou namte aw;
heading: Kisik Ding A Ngetna
english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

paite: thupiak akuankhiak ma a, buhsi bang a hon mutmang ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna kihtakhuai ahong tun ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna ni ahong tun ma in kikaikhawm un.
english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the day of Yahweh’s anger comes on you.

paite: Avaihawmna zui, nou lei a minunnem tengtengte aw, TOUPA zong un; diktatna zong un, migitna zong un; TOUPA hehna ni ah sel in na om kha thei uhi.
english: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh’s anger.

paite: Gaza lah nutsiat in a-om dia, Ashkelon hihgawp in; suntang lai in Ashdod ahawlkhe ding ua, Ekron akizungkalh ding hi.
heading: Israel Kim A Namte Tunggikna
english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

paite: Tuipi piau a teng Kereth namte aw na tung uh agik hi! TOUPA thu in noute ahon dem hi, Kanaan aw, Philistiate gam a teng om lou ding in ka hon hihgawp ding.
english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! Yahweh’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

paite: Huchi in tuipi, piaute louhing nou mun ahi ding a, belamchingte innte leh belamhonte ahuangte ahi ding hi.
english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

paite: Huai piau bel Judah inkuan khosuaksunte a ding ahi ding; huai ah abelamhonte uh avak ding uh; nitaklam in Ashkelon innte ah akual ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian un amaute aveh in, sal a atang uh pikhe nawn ding ahih ziak in.
english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, will visit them and restore them.

paite: Moab hon kouna leh Ammon tate gensiatna ka zata hi. Akigitpihte uh tung a kiliansak a, ka mite gam dou asawm uhi.
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ka hin bang in, "Chihtaktak in Moab, Sodom bang ahi ding a, Ammon tate Gomorrah bang, lou bineite leh chikhukte mun sia asuakden ding a, ka mi omlaite'n alok ding ua, ka nam omlaite'n amaute aluah ding uhi.”
english: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA mite tung a akiletsak ua, akou ziak un, akisak-theihna ziak un sawi in a-om ding uhi.
english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Amaute tung ah TOUPA alauhuai ding a; lei pathiante tengteng kial in ahihbei chiang in michih in amau mun chiat leh namte' tuikulh gam tengteng nangawn in amah abe ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

paite: Nou Ethiopiate leng, ka namsau a thah a om ding na hi uhi.
english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

paite: Huan ama'n mallam dou in akhut alikkhe ding a, Assuria ahihse ding; Nineveh akisegawp ding a, huchi in gamdai bang in akeu ding uh.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

paite: Alai ah belamte akual ding ua, namte ganta tengteng; vangawngsau leh sakuh achial tungnung ah agiak ding ua; tohlet ah a-aw in la asa ding uh; sangkilte ah siatgawpna a-om ding; sidar sing a nasepte ahihsiat ziak in.
english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

paite: Hiai khopi nuamsa pilvang loutak a teng a, "Alungtang a keimah ka hi, kei lou kuamah dang a-om kei," chi ahi; bangchidan a hong segawp a, gantate a dia kualna ding hi ahia; kuapeuh akiang a pai in anuihsan in, akhut alehkhum ding uhi.
english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.
